section_summary.extract_value: This discussion section confirms that gratitude is negatively correlated with loneliness, supporting hypothesis one. For hypothesis two, social support was found to have only a partial mediating effect on gratitude and loneliness, which is attributed to Chinese international students in this study receiving significantly less social support. The section elaborates on the difficulties these students face in obtaining family and friendship support due to cultural differences, time zones, and challenges in forming deep friendships in a foreign country, with the COVID-19 pandemic highlighted as an exacerbating factor.
